title: OpenMed Persian PII Masking OpenPII 690k Clean Dataset
supported_claim: 848,846 rows synthetic Persian PII dataset localized from English AI4Privacy corpus with train (783,666), validation (32,518), and test (32,662) splits
evidence_notes: Parquet split audit confirms 848,846 total rows across 3 splits. Zero exact source_text duplicate strings cross-split, but 15% seed_uid overlap between test and validation splits.

title: OpenMed Persian PII Masking OpenPII 690k Initial Clean Dataset
supported_claim: Initial uncleaned baseline dataset before deduplication and refinement in OpenMed Persian development pipeline
evidence_notes: Precursor dataset used in OpenMed Persian development pipeline prior to final cleaning.

title: OpenMed Persian PII TookaBERT-Large ONNX INT4
supported_claim: Claims dense held-out test F1 ~0.9800 on Persian PII token classification
evidence_notes: Quantized ONNX MatMulNBits INT4 model based on PartAI/TookaBERT-Large (Apache-2.0). 39 BIO output labels representing 19 semantic entity types. Artifact size 343.96 MB (SHA256: 88e8bcf61c0212196437997599d43f157718112516473143b2a5d897613a6c94).

title: OpenMed Persian PII Google mBERT ONNX INT4
supported_claim: Claims dense held-out test F1 ~0.9708 on Persian PII token classification
evidence_notes: Quantized ONNX MatMulNBits INT4 model based on google-bert/bert-base-multilingual-cased (Apache-2.0). 39 BIO output labels representing 19 semantic entity types. Artifact size 395.36 MB (SHA256: 80eb7840b030def052e8f19d7a1692c334ae39f9f06b7be73150ee94d5c22b15).

title: TookaBERT-Large Base Foundation Model
supported_claim: Pretrained Persian RoBERTa-style language model with 24 layers and 1024 hidden size
evidence_notes: Base foundation model for TookaBERT PII fine-tuning. Apache-2.0 license.

title: BERT Multilingual Base Cased Foundation Model
supported_claim: Multilingual BERT masked language model supporting 104 languages including Persian
evidence_notes: Base foundation model for mBERT PII fine-tuning. Apache-2.0 license.

title: BERT Persian Base Uncased NER PEYMA
supported_claim: Persian general NER model fine-tuned on PEYMA corpus for Person, Org, Loc, Date, Time, Money, Percent
evidence_notes: Baseline model used by fa-redact opt-in PersianNERDetector for PERSON entity detection.

title: ParsiKit Python Package
supported_claim: Persian NLP and string utilities including validation, text cleaning, and masking
evidence_notes: Project metadata in ParsiKit 3.3.0 declares MIT license. Contains single-string type classifiers and single-field star-masking functions. Does not support document PII redaction, native offset retention, or stateful pseudonymization.

title: py-persian-tools Python Package
supported_claim: Python implementation of Persian utilities for national ID, mobile, card, sheba, and legal ID
evidence_notes: Evaluated PyPI package version 0.0.11 provides single-value validators and card number text regex utilities without document-level PII span redaction. Distinguish clearly from older PyPI 0.0.11 package.

title: persian-tools TypeScript Package
supported_claim: TypeScript/JavaScript Persian utility library with high-performance validator algorithms
evidence_notes: Prior-art reference for Iranian validator logic, legal ID arithmetic, and digit normalization.

title: DadmaTools Persian NLP Toolkit
supported_claim: Persian NLP pipeline including tokenization, POS, dependency parsing, and NER
evidence_notes: General Persian NLP toolkit with Spacy/Transformers wrappers; not specialized for PII de-identification or pseudonymization.

title: AI4Privacy OpenPII 1M Multilingual Dataset
supported_claim: 1M multilingual synthetic PII corpus used as English source for OpenMed Persian localization
evidence_notes: Source corpus from which synthetic Persian records were translated and localized. Current upstream repository metadata declares CC-BY-4.0 license; historical repository metadata evolved across releases.
